name: John Deere Power Products - Greeneville TN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in 2023-11 Street View: a controlled, fully fenced truck entrance on the NE access drive (~36.1552, -82.8882). Chain-link perimeter fence with sliding gate sections; entrance lane pinch-point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed: a small white guard booth (~1-vehicle footprint) set beside the entrance lane, visible in Street View and z20 satellite. Staffed checkpoint controlling truck access into the plant.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a physical staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved area inside the gate before the dock banks can hold queuing trucks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The plant access road runs several hundred metres from the Hal Henard Rd junction to the gate, then continues to the dock areas - ample stacking for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+: multiple long building faces with continuous dock-door rhythm, dozens of trailers backed in across at least 3-4 dock banks (z19 imagery shows two long rows of 20+ trailers each). Counted ~60 - high-volume freight operation.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop / staging across several yard areas plus finished-goods staging; banded 25-50. Note the large west-side racks store finished mowers/tractors, not trailers - excluded from this count.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Multiple physically separate dock banks on different building faces - shipping and receiving run from distinct clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits among farmland and woods on the rural edge of Greene County; surrounding land is open pasture and forest - Rural.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single inbound lane through the gate observed; low confidence on exact lane split at the booth.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh platform observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SW property edge, but no spur was observed entering the plant - railServed false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Developed/fenced plant area estimated ~95 acres; perimeter bounding box is larger because the property is an irregular footprint with open field margins.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural setting but the facility is large, active, and near Greeneville with utility infrastructure - cellular coverage likely adequate; left false, flagged uncertain.
